40009151.author: पदार्थः
40009151.content: हनुमान् Hanuman, ऋष्यमूकात् from Rishyamuka, मलयं Malaya, गिरिम् mountain, गत्वा on going, कपिराजाय to the lord of the monkeys, तदा then, वीरौ the two heroes, राघवौ Raghavas, आचचक्षे  seeing announced (the arrival)

40009151.author: Translation
40009151.content: Leaving Rishyamuka, Hanuman reached the Malaya mountain. Seeing the chief of monkeys there, he announced the arrival of  the heroic Raghavas.

40009152.author: पदार्थः
40009152.content: महाप्राज्ञः very wise, दृढविक्रम: unfailing in valour, अयं रामः this Rama, भ्रात्रा with brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, सम्प्राप्तः has arrived, अयं रामः this Rama, सत्यविक्रमः  endowed with the power of truth

40009152.author: Translation
40009152.content: 'This Rama of greatwisdom and valour, endowed with the power of truth has arrived here along with his brother Lakshmana.

40009153.author: पदार्थः
40009153.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of Ikshvakus, कुले in the race, जातः he is born, दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, रामः Rama, धर्मे in righteousness, निगदितश्चैव is noteworthy, पितुः father's, निर्देशपारगः

40009153.author: Translation
40009153.content: 'Born in the Ikshvaku race Rama Dasaratha's son, distinguished for his righteousness is here to carry out the orders of his father.

40009154.author: पदार्थः
40009154.content: अरण्ये in the forest, वसतः  living , नियतस्य  self controlled , तस्य his, अस्य this man, महात्मनः great man's, भार्या wife, रावणेन by Ravana, हृता is abducted, सः he, त्वाम् to you, शरणम् आगतः has come to you to seek refuge

40009154.author: Translation
40009154.content: 'While the great Rama armed with selfrestraint was living in the forest, his wife was abducted by Ravana. So he has come to you seeing refuge.

40009155.author: पदार्थः
40009155.content: येन by whom, राजसूयाश्वमेधैश्च by Rajasuya and Aswamedha yajnas, वह्निः god of fire, अभितर्पितः is gratified, तथा so also, शतसहस्रशः in hundreds and thousands, गावः cows, दक्षिणाः sacrificial gifts, उत्सृष्टाः येन by whom given, तपसा by practising religious austerity, सत्यवाक्येन  justly, वसुधा earth, पालिता is ruled, तस्य his, पुत्रः son, अयं रामः this is Rama, स्त्री हेतोः on account of a woman, शरणम् refuge, समागतः came here

40009155.author: Translation
40009155.content: 'This Rama, son of a king who had gratified the firegod through many yajnas like  Rajasuya and Aswamedha, gifted hundreds of thousands of cows and ruled this earth with truth and austerity, has come seeking help for a woman.'

40009156.author: पदार्थः
40009156.content: येन by whom, राजसूयाश्वमेधैश्च by Rajasuya and Aswamedha yajnas, वह्निः god of fire, अभितर्पितः is gratified, तथा so also, शतसहस्रशः in hundreds and thousands, गावः cows, दक्षिणाः sacrificial gifts, उत्सृष्टाः येन by whom given, तपसा by practising religious austerity, सत्यवाक्येन  justly, वसुधा earth, पालिता is ruled, तस्य his, पुत्रः son, अयं रामः this is Rama, स्त्री हेतोः on account of a woman, शरणम् refuge, समागतः came here

40009156.author: Translation
40009156.content: 'This Rama, son of a king who had gratified the firegod through many yajnas like  Rajasuya and Aswamedha, gifted hundreds of thousands of cows and ruled this earth with truth and austerity, has come seeking help for a woman.'

40009157.author: पदार्थः
40009157.content: भ्रातरौ  brothers, तौ  both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, भवता by you, सख्यकामौ for friendship, पूजनीयतमौ are worthiest of worship, एतौ both of them, उभौ both, प्रतिगृह्य  may receive, अर्चयस्व  welcome with all reverence

40009157.author: Translation
40009157.content: 'Both the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana seek friendship with you. As both of them are worthiest of worship, welcome them with due reverence.'

40009158.author: पदार्थः
40009158.content: हृष्टमानसः delighted at heart, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हनुमतः Hanuman's, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, भयं च and fear, राघवा Raghava, घोरं  terrible, प्रजहौ abandoned, विगतज्वरः devoid of fear, प्रीत्या lovingly, दर्शनीयतमः most attractive, सकृत्वा having taken, मानुषं रूपं human form, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्लवगर्षभः best among monkeys, भूत्वा having given up, राघवम् of  Raghava,  (प्र)उवाच said,

40009158.author: Translation
40009158.content: Hanuman's words took away Sugriva's great fear for Rama and filled him with cheer. This bull among monkeys gave up his natural appearance and and assuming an attractive human form spoke to Rama lovingly:

40009159.author: पदार्थः
40009159.content: हृष्टमानसः delighted at heart, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हनुमतः Hanuman's, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, भयं च and fear, राघवा Raghava, घोरं  terrible, प्रजहौ abandoned, विगतज्वरः devoid of fear, प्रीत्या lovingly, दर्शनीयतमः most attractive, सकृत्वा having taken, मानुषं रूपं human form, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्लवगर्षभः best among monkeys, भूत्वा having given up, राघवम् of  Raghava,  (प्र)उवाच said,

40009159.author: Translation
40009159.content: Hanuman's words took away Sugriva's great fear for Rama and filled him with cheer. This bull among monkeys gave up his natural appearance and and assuming an attractive human form spoke to Rama lovingly:

40009160.author: पदार्थः
40009160.content: भवान् you, धर्मविनीतश्च educated in all dharmas, विक्रान्तः a great hero, सर्ववत्सलः kind to all beings, भवद्गुणाः your virtues, वायुपुत्रेण by the son of the windgod, तत्त्वतः truly, मे to me, आख्याताः apprised

40009160.author: Translation
40009160.content: 'You are a great hero, affectionate to all and wellversed in all dharmas. The son of the Windgod has, in fact, apprised me  of your virtues

40009161.author: पदार्थः
40009161.content: प्रभो O Lord, तत् that, त्वम् you, वानरेण by a monkey, मया सह with me, सौहार्दम् friendship, इच्छसि (इति) यत् that you are wishing, एषः that way, ममैव for myself, सत्कारः an honour, उत्तमः best, लाभश्च benefit

40009161.author: Translation
40009161.content: 'O Lord that you are eager to have friendship with me, who is a monkey is a great honour and is extremely beneficial to me.

40009162.author: पदार्थः
40009162.content: वा if , सख्यम् friendship, रोचते यदि is desired, एषः this is, बाहुः my arm, प्रसारितः stretched, पाणिना on my hand, पाणिः your hand, गृह्यताम् may be received, ध्रुवा firm, मर्यादा  with due2 2regard, बध्यताम् may be bound

40009162.author: Translation
40009162.content: 'If you are desirous of my friendship, here is my arm (palm) stretched out to you. With due regard, establish our bond firmly, holding my palm in yours.'

40009163.author: पदार्थः
40009163.content: सुग्रीवेण(सुग्रीवस्य) Sugriva's, सुभाषितम् wellsaid,एतत् this,वचनम् word,श्रुत्वा having heard, सम्प्रहृष्टमनाः became very happy, पाणिना with the hand, हस्तम् hand, पीडयामास pressed, सौहृदम् affectionately, आलम्ब्य maintaining, हृद्यं delighted , पीडितम्  getting close, पर्यष्वजत firmly hugged

40009163.author: Translation
40009163.content: Rama became very happy to hear Sugriva's warm words and pressed his hand with his. Delighted, he went close  to Sugriva and hugged him tightly and  affectionately.

40009164.author: पदार्थः
40009164.content: ततः thereafter, अरिन्दमः vanquisher of enemies, हनुमान् Hanuman, भिक्षुरूपम् mendicant form, सन्त्यज्य giving up, स्वेन by his real, रूपेण form, काष्ठयोः two pieces of wood, पावकम् fire, जनयामास generated, ततः then, दीप्यमानम् glowing, सत्कृतम् a spot of worship, वह्निम्  into fire, पुष्पैः of flowers, अभ्यर्च्य made an offering, सुसमाहितः vigilant, सुप्रीतः a pleased one, तयोः of them, मध्ये in between, निदधे placed

40009164.author: Translation
40009164.content: Then, Hanuman vanquisher of enemies, gave up his guise of a mendicant, assumed his natural form and generated fire by rubbing two pieces of wood. Wellpleased at heart, he made an offering of flowers to the flaming fire and placed it between them.

40009165.author: पदार्थः
40009165.content: ततः thereafter, अरिन्दमः vanquisher of enemies, हनुमान् Hanuman, भिक्षुरूपम् mendicant form, सन्त्यज्य giving up, स्वेन by his real, रूपेण form, काष्ठयोः two pieces of wood, पावकम् fire, जनयामास generated, ततः then, दीप्यमानम् glowing, सत्कृतम् a spot of worship, वह्निम्  into fire, पुष्पैः of flowers, अभ्यर्च्य made an offering, सुसमाहितः vigilant, सुप्रीतः a pleased one, तयोः of them, मध्ये in between, निदधे placed

40009165.author: Translation
40009165.content: Then, Hanuman vanquisher of enemies, gave up his guise of a mendicant, assumed his natural form and generated fire by rubbing two pieces of wood. Wellpleased at heart, he made an offering of flowers to the flaming fire and placed it between them.

40009166.author: पदार्थः
40009166.content: ततः then, तौ both of them, दीप्यमानम् blazing, अग्निम् fire, प्रदक्षिणं चक्रतुः went round, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राघवश्चैव and Raghava also, वयस्यत्वम् friendship, उपागतौ  both established

40009166.author: Translation
40009166.content: They both circumambulated the blazing fire and solemnized their friendship.

40009167.author: पदार्थः
40009167.content: ततः then, सुप्रीतमनसौ both delighted at heart, तौ both, हरिराघवौ Sugriva and Rama, उभौ both, अन्योन्यम् each other, अभिवीक्षन्तौ looking at each other, तृप्तिम् contented, न अभिजग्मतुः  yet not fully content

40009167.author: Translation
40009167.content: Rama and the monkey contented at heart, yet not fully content, continued looking at each other.

40009168.author: पदार्थः
40009168.content: त्वम् you, मे to me, हृद्यः dear, वयस्यः friend, असि you are, नौ for both of us, सुखम् pleasure, दुःखं च and sorrow, ह्येकम् are one and the same, इति thus, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्रहृष्टवत् happy, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.

40009168.author: Translation
40009168.content: 'You are a dear friend to me. Your sorrow is my sorrow, your pleasure is my  pleasure. We are one and the same' said Sugriva to Rama, his heart overflowing with happiness.

40009169.author: पदार्थः
40009169.content: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सालस्य of a Sala tree, सुपर्णबहुलाम् with luxuriant leaves, सुपुष्पिताम् wellblossomed, शाखाम् branch, छित्वा cut, आस्तीर्य spread, सराघवः along with Rama, निषसाद sat down.

40009169.author: Translation
40009169.content: Then Sugriva cut the branch of a sala tree with luxuriant leaves and flowers, spread it on the ground and sat down along with Raghava.

40009170.author: पदार्थः
40009170.content: अथ then, संहृष्टः very happy, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, हनुमान् Hanuman, चन्दनवृक्षस्य sandal tree, परमपुष्पिताम् full of flowers, शाखाम् branch, लक्ष्मणाय to Lakshmana, ददौ gave.

40009170.author: Translation
40009170.content: Then Hanuman, the bull among monkeys, felt very happy, cut the branch of a sandalwood tree full of flowers and gave it to Lakshmana.

40009171.author: पदार्थः
40009171.content: ततः then, प्रहृष्टः overwhelmed with joy, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हर्षव्याकुललोचनः eyes sparkling with joy, तदा then, रामम् Rama, मधुरया in sweet, गिरा with words, श्लक्ष्णम् gently, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40009171.author: Translation
40009171.content: Then Sugriva, eyes sparkling with joy, replied to Rama in a sweet, gentle voice.

40009172.author: पदार्थः
40009172.content: राम Rama, अहम् I, विनिकृतः badly insulted, हृतभार्यः wife hijacked, भयार्दितः stricken with fear, इह here, वने in the forest, चरामि I am moving, त्रस्तः frightened, दुर्गम् in accessible, एतत् this, उपाश्रितः taken refuge.

40009172.author: Translation
40009172.content: 'O Rama, I have been insulted deeply and my wife hijacked. Stricken with fear I have taken refuge in this inaccessible forest.

40009173.author: पदार्थः
40009173.content: राघव O Rama, भ्रात्रा by my brother, वालिना Vali, निकृतः humiliated, कृतवैरश्च developed enmity, सः अहम् such a person, त्रस्तः frightened, उद्भ्रान्तचेतनः with unsteady mind, वने in the forest, भीतः fearing, वसामि I am living.

40009173.author: Translation
40009173.content: 'O Rama humiliated by my brother Vali, I have developed enmity with him. Terribly distraught and disturbed I live in this forest in great fear.

40009174.author: पदार्थः
40009174.content: महाभाग reverend, वालिनः from Vali, भयार्तस्य feeling helpless with fear, मे to me, अभयम् security, कुरु give me, काकुत्स्थ Kakusta, मे यथा as I, भयम् fear, न भवेत् may not be, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought to.

40009174.author: Translation
40009174.content: 'O reverend Kakutstha, I feel helpless with fear from Vali. Save me. You should release me free from fear.'

40009175.author: पदार्थः
40009175.content: एवम् that way, उक्तः having addressed, तेजस्वी glorious, धर्मज्ञः righteous man, धर्मवत्सलः   lover of dharma, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, प्रहसन्निव with gentle smile on the face, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, प्रत्यभाषत replied.

40009175.author: Translation
40009175.content: The righteous and glorious Rama to whom dharma is very dear said to Sugriva with a gentle smile on his face, when he was entreated thus:

40009176.author: पदार्थः
40009176.content: महाकपे O great monkey, मित्रम् a friend, उपकारफलम् result of doing a good deed, मे to me, विदितम् is known, तव your, भार्यापहारिणम् one who has stolen your wife, तं वालिनम् that Valin, वधिष्यामि I will kill.

40009176.author: Translation
40009176.content: 'O great monkey I know friendship is the fruit of a beneficial deed. I will kill that Vali who has usurped your wife.

40009177.author: पदार्थः
40009177.content: अमोघाः unfailing, सूर्यसङ्कशाः comparable to Sun, निशिताः sharp, कङ्कपत्रप्रतिच्छन्नाः covered with the feathers of a kanka bird, महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः equal to great India's thunderbolt, तीक्ष्णाग्राः with a sharp tip, ऋजुपर्वाणः straight, सरोषाः angry, भुजगाः इव like serpents, इमे these, मम शराः my arrows, वेगिताः soon, दुर्वृत्ते at the miscreant, तस्मिन् at him, वालिनि at Vali, निपतिष्यन्ति they will strike.

40009177.author: Translation
40009177.content: 'These arrows covered with kanka feathers, sharp and straight at the tip, comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt are (burning bright) like the sun. Looking like angry serpents, they will unfailingly strike at the miscreant Vali soon.

40009178.author: पदार्थः
40009178.content: अमोघाः unfailing, सूर्यसङ्कशाः comparable to Sun, निशिताः sharp, कङ्कपत्रप्रतिच्छन्नाः covered with the feathers of a kanka bird, महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः equal to great India's thunderbolt, तीक्ष्णाग्राः with a sharp tip, ऋजुपर्वाणः straight, सरोषाः angry, भुजगाः इव like serpents, इमे these, मम शराः my arrows, वेगिताः soon, दुर्वृत्ते at the miscreant, तस्मिन् at him, वालिनि at Vali, निपतिष्यन्ति they will strike.

40009178.author: Translation
40009178.content: 'These arrows covered with kanka feathers, sharp and straight at the tip, comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt are (burning bright) like the sun. Looking like angry serpents, they will unfailingly strike at the miscreant Vali soon.

40009179.author: पदार्थः
40009179.content: अद्य now, आशीविषोपमैः comparable to serpents, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, विनिहतम् killed, भूमौ on the ground, प्रकीर्णम् will fall shattered, पर्वतमिव like a mountain, वालिनम् Vali, पश्य see.

40009179.author: Translation
40009179.content: 'With these sharp, serpentlike arrows Vali will be killed. He will fall down on the ground like a mountain shattered.You will see it now'.

40009180.author: पदार्थः
40009180.content: सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, आत्मनः for himself, हितम् welfare, राघवस्य Rama's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, परमप्रीतः very much pleased, सुमहान् very great, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

40009180.author: Translation
40009180.content: Sugriva, very much pleased with the words of Rama, spoke highly (of him).

40009181.author: पदार्थः
40009181.content: नृसिंह lion among men, तव your, प्रसादेन by your grace, अहम् I am, प्रियां च wife and, राज्यं च kingdom, समाप्नुयाम् will attain, नरदेव king, सः he, पुनः again, यथा as, निहंस्यद्य will destroy, तथा thus, त्वम् you, वैरिणम् enemy, मम अग्रजम् my elder brother, कुरु do.

40009181.author: Translation
40009181.content: 'O Rama, by your grace I will get my wife and kingdom back. O king accomplish this so that I can destroy my, elder brother, my enemy, O lion among men

40009182.author: पदार्थः
40009182.content: सुग्रीवरामप्रणयप्रसङ्गे while Sugriva and Rama were making a friendly alliance, सीताकपीन्द्रक्षणदाचराणाम् Sita's, Vali's and also Ravana's, राजीवहेमज्वलनोपमानि lotuslike and blazing like gold, वामानिनेत्राणि left eyes, समम् equally, स्फुरन्ति throbbed.

40009182.author: Translation
40009182.content: While Sugriva was making a friendly alliance with Rama, Sita's left eye, like lotus, Vali's left eye glittering like gold and Ravana's left eye blazing (like fire) twitched at the same time for a moment (Twitching of left eye is considered auspicious to a woman and ominous to a man). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे पञ्चमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
